findings.description: Get-ReviewAuthorityStorePath performs only GetFullPath plus a lexical prefix comparison. Write-ReviewAuthorityImmutableFact then calls Directory.CreateDirectory and FileStream CreateNew on the result, both of which follow an existing symlink or junction at the store root or any campaign/run ancestor. The public command places this controller-owned store at the project path .specrew/review/authority, so a linked component can redirect immutable authority facts and directory creation outside the selected store/repository. Resolve and contain every existing component, or reject reparse points, before any authority-store enumeration, directory creation, read, or write; add a real linked-ancestor regression.
findings.title: Authority-store writes follow project-controlled linked ancestors

findings.description: The case probe obtains a real entry name from enumeration but decides whether its flipped spelling resolves with Directory.Exists or File.Exists. Those APIs follow a link target and both report false for a dangling symbolic link. On a case-folding volume, a listed dangling entry such as Alpha can therefore make the flipped alpha lookup look absent, causing the function to return case-sensitive and cache the wrong comparer. That comparer feeds containment, authority-store, verification-path, machinery, and digest decisions. Use a link-aware directory-entry lookup that tests the entry itself without following its target, and cover a dangling-link fixture in the volume differential harness.
findings.title: A dangling link can poison the cached volume case verdict

findings.description: DRIFT-198-I009-040 explicitly requires a case-distinct fixture, but the final change adds only a self-test for the widened structural regex. The existing consumer firewall fixture still creates a single docs/instructions.md file, so no test runs the shipped scanner over docs/Policy.md and docs/policy.md and proves that both reach finding generation on a case-sensitive volume. This class has already escaped structural checks repeatedly. Add a measured-volume fixture with mandates in both case-distinct files and assert both are reported.
findings.title: The required case-distinct scanner regression was not added

summary: Both controller-declared verification commands succeeded against the exact target digest. Risk-based inspection found two remaining major defects in authority-store and path-identity containment plus one missing required regression fixture. The final Pester terminal-result gate and ordinal consumer-scanner deduplication are otherwise consistent with their reported corrections.
